# Subscription & DTC Ecom Patterns
# KB: ~/.claude/memory/design/ecom/subscription-dtc-patterns.md
# Owner: elio (Ecom Design) + koda (Stack A backend)
# Updated: 2026-04-27

---

## 1. SUBSCRIBE-AND-SAVE WIDGET

### WHEN
Any DTC PDP where subscription is a core revenue driver. Implement when repeat-purchase rate > 20% or AOV uplift target is 15%+.

### WHY
Subscribe-and-save converts one-time buyers into LTV machines. Skio reports 30–45% of DTC revenue comes from subscriptions when the widget is above the fold, integrated into the ATC flow, and shows a clear savings delta.

### STRUCTURE

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ○  One-time purchase         $49.00             │
│  ●  Subscribe & Save          $39.20  SAVE 20%  │
│     ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐│
│     │ Deliver every  [30 days ▼]                ││
│     └───────────────────────────────────────────┘│
│     ✓ Cancel or pause anytime                    │
│     ✓ Free shipping on every order               │
│     ✓ Loyalty points on every charge             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### SPEC

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Widget position | Immediately above ATC button |
| Radio style | Large tap targets, min 44px height per option |
| Default selection | Subscribe (pre-select for AOV; A/B test vs. one-time default) |
| Savings display | Show absolute ($9.80 off) AND relative (20%) simultaneously |
| Frequency selector | Dropdown OR stepper; expose 2–4 options max |
| Trust micro-copy | 3 bullet max: cancel, shipping, loyalty |
| Discount badge | High-contrast pill: `bg-brand-accent text-white text-xs font-semibold` |
| Animation | Slide-open frequency selector when Subscribe selected (150ms ease-out) |

### BRAND EXAMPLES

- **AG1 (Athletic Greens):** Pre-selects subscribe, hides one-time price until toggled, frequency locked to 30-day. High conversion but low transparency — works because brand trust is established.
- **Skio-powered stores:** Frequency stepper with visual calendar preview. Cancel-anytime copy in green. Loyalty multiplier shown inline.
- **Recharge storefronts:** Classic radio group, discount pill, bullet trust icons. Widely A/B tested — safe baseline.
- **OLIPOP:** Flavor + quantity + frequency selector in unified widget. Gamified "build your box" UI.

### HYDROGEN COMPONENT REFERENCE

```tsx
// components/product/SubscriptionWidget.tsx
import {useProduct} from '@shopify/hydrogen-react';

interface SubscriptionWidgetProps {
  sellingPlanGroups: NonNullable<
    ReturnType<typeof useProduct>['sellingPlanGroups']
  >;
  selectedSellingPlan: string | null;
  onSellingPlanChange: (planId: string | null) => void;
  basePrice: string;
}

// Selling plan groups come from Storefront API ProductFragment
// fragment ProductSubscription on SellingPlanGroup {
//   name
//   sellingPlans(first: 4) {
//     nodes { id name priceAdjustments { adjustmentValue } }
//   }
// }
```

### ANTI-PATTERNS

- Do NOT hide the one-time option entirely — dark pattern, drives chargebacks
- Do NOT use confusing "subscription" language — say "Subscribe & Save" or "Auto-Refill"
- Do NOT show frequency selector for one-time option
- Do NOT require account creation before subscribing — major conversion killer
- Do NOT bury cancel-anytime copy below the fold

---

## 2. SUBSCRIPTION MANAGEMENT PORTAL (CUSTOMER ACCOUNT)

### WHEN
Any brand running subscriptions needs a self-service portal. Reduces support tickets by 60–70% (Skio benchmark). Required before scaling subscription to > 500 active subs.

### WHY
The #1 reason for subscription churn is inability to self-manage (pause, swap, reschedule). Every support action that can be self-served is churn prevented and CAC recovered.

### STRUCTURE

```
My Subscriptions
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  [Product Image]  AG1 Athletic Greens — 30 servings
                   $39.20/month · Next charge: May 15
                   
                   [Skip Next]  [Reschedule]  [Swap]
                   [Pause]      [Cancel]
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Upcoming order: May 15, 2026
  [Edit Items]  [Edit Address]  [Edit Payment]
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

### SPEC

| Feature | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Skip next order | One-tap, no confirmation modal needed |
| Reschedule | Date picker, show next 3 available dates |
| Pause | Duration selector (1 month / 2 months / 3 months / indefinite) |
| Cancel flow | 3-step: reason → save offer → confirm. Save offer = discount or pause |
| Swap product | Variant selector within same product line; cross-sell secondary |
| Edit quantity | Stepper with min=1 |
| Edit address | Inline form, no page navigation |
| Edit payment | Redirect to payment method flow (Recharge/Skio handles tokenization) |

### SAVE OFFER (CANCEL PREVENTION)

```
Before you cancel...
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Why are you cancelling?
  ○ Too expensive
  ○ Have too much product
  ○ Didn't see results
  ○ Other
  
  [Continue to Cancel]  [Accept Offer →]
  
  // If "Too expensive" → show 15% loyalty discount for next 3 months
  // If "Have too much product" → show "Skip 2 months" option
```

### BRAND EXAMPLES

- **Skio portal:** Clean card layout, inline editing, "snooze" UX for skipping. Best-in-class cancellation save flow.
- **Recharge Customer Portal v2:** Modal-based editing, less native feel but widely deployed.
- **AG1:** Custom-built portal with streak tracking ("Your 180-day streak"). Gamification dramatically reduces pause/cancel.
- **HUM Nutrition:** Shows "health goals" progress alongside subscription management — contextual retention.

### HYDROGEN / SHOPIFY CUSTOMER ACCOUNT API

```graphql
# Uses Shopify Customer Account API (new, not Storefront API)
# Requires Hydrogen's unstable_useCustomerAccount hook

query GetSubscriptionContracts {
  customer {
    subscriptionContracts(first: 10) {
      nodes {
        id
        status
        nextBillingDate
        lines(first: 5) {
          nodes {
            productVariant { title price { amount } }
            quantity
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### ANTI-PATTERNS

- Do NOT require email + password re-auth to cancel — adds friction that feels hostile
- Do NOT make cancel button hard to find (hidden, grey on grey) — FTCA violation risk
- Do NOT offer only "Cancel" with no save flow — missed retention revenue
- Do NOT auto-skip the save offer if user selects "Didn't see results" — highest churn risk, needs personal outreach trigger

---

## 3. BUILD-YOUR-BOX / SUBSCRIPTION BUNDLE

### WHEN
Multi-SKU brands (CPG, supplements, snacks, beauty) offering bundle subscriptions. Use when catalog > 5 SKUs and bundle AOV can exceed individual item sum.

### WHY
Bundles increase AOV, reduce churn (customers get variety), and create perceived value. OLIPOP, Graza, and Cometeer all built significant revenue on bundle subscription models.

### STRUCTURE

```
Build Your Box  ────────────────── 12 of 12 selected
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Progress bar: [████████████░░░░░░] 8/12

  FLAVORS
  ┌──────┐ ┌──────┐ ┌──────┐ ┌──────┐
  │ Img  │ │ Img  │ │ Img  │ │ Img  │
  │ -  2 +│ │ -  0 +│ │ -  4 +│ │ -  2 +│
  │Lemon │ │Grape │ │Straw │ │Cream │
  └──────┘ └──────┘ └──────┘ └──────┘

  SUMMARY BAR (sticky bottom)
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  12 cans selected  ·  $29.99/month  [Subscribe →]
```

### SPEC

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Box capacity indicator | Progress bar + `{n}/{max}` counter, sticky header |
| Stepper controls | − and + buttons, 44px minimum, disabled state when 0/max reached |
| Validation | Block ATC until box is full; show helper text "Add 4 more" |
| Quantity per SKU | Allow 0 (not in box), enforce max per SKU if applicable |
| Summary bar | Sticky bottom on mobile, sticky sidebar on desktop |
| Pricing display | Show per-unit price + total; update live as quantity changes |
| Animation | Smooth progress bar fill (300ms ease), counter pulse on change |

### HYDROGEN COMPONENT REFERENCE

```tsx
// Custom bundle logic — not native Shopify bundle product
// Approach 1: Use Cart Attributes to track bundle composition
// Approach 2: Use Shopify Bundles app (metafield-based)

// Cart transform for bundle pricing:
// Store bundle items as cart attributes, apply discount via Cart Transform API
// or Shopify Scripts (Plus only)

interface BundleItem {
  variantId: string;
  quantity: number;
  title: string;
  imageUrl: string;
}

// useBundle hook manages local state, syncs to cart on Submit
```

### BRAND EXAMPLES

- **OLIPOP:** 12-can variety pack builder. Uses scroll-snap flavor carousel on mobile. Real-time "Your box" sidebar.
- **Cometeer:** Coffee bundle builder with roast-intensity sliders and origin tags. Visual-heavy, premium feel.
- **Graza:** "Drizzle or Pour" bundle. Simple 2-SKU stepper. Proves bundles work even with tiny catalogs.
- **Magic Spoon:** Cereal flavor box builder. Gamified with "flavor personality quiz" entry point.

### ANTI-PATTERNS

- Do NOT allow partial box submission without clear warning
- Do NOT show out-of-stock flavors in the builder without clear visual differentiation
- Do NOT reset the box on page refresh without localStorage persistence
- Do NOT use complex multi-step wizard for < 6 SKU boxes — single-page is always better

---

## 4. SUBSCRIPTION UPSELL — POST-CHECKOUT

### WHEN
Customer just completed a one-time purchase. Show subscription upsell on the order confirmation page (thank you page). Shopify Plus required for post-checkout extensibility.

### WHY
Post-checkout upsells convert at 15–25% because buyer anxiety is gone — the purchase decision is made. Subscription conversion is highest in this state. Recharge reports 18% average uptake on post-purchase subscription offers.

### STRUCTURE

```
Your order is confirmed! 🎉

  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  NEVER RUN OUT                                   │
  │                                                  │
  │  Subscribe to your order and save 20%            │
  │  $39.20/month  ←  was $49.00                     │
  │                                                  │
  │  Deliver every  [30 days ▼]                      │
  │                                                  │
  │  [Yes, Subscribe & Save 20%]                     │
  │  [No thanks]                                     │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### SPEC

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Trigger | Only show if purchased item has selling plan |
| Headline | Urgency + value: "Never Run Out" / "Save 20% Forever" |
| CTA | High-contrast primary button; "No thanks" as text link only |
| Frequency | Pre-filled to most common interval; editable |
| Timing | Show immediately on confirmation page, not in email |
| API | Shopify Checkout Extensions (post-purchase) + Recharge/Skio webhook |

### ANTI-PATTERNS

- Do NOT show if customer already subscribed
- Do NOT require re-entering payment info (use stored payment method)
- Do NOT show more than one upsell offer on confirmation page

---

## 5. LOYALTY + SUBSCRIPTION INTEGRATION

### WHEN
Subscription brands with > 1000 active subscribers. Loyalty programs reduce churn by 25–35% when points are tied to subscription renewals (Yotpo data).

### WHY
The lock-in effect of loyalty points creates a switching cost. Each renewal earns points, each skip/cancel costs "streaks." Behavioral economics (loss aversion) keeps subscribers active.

### STRUCTURE

```
  Your Subscription Perks
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  🔥 60-day streak  →  +2x points this month
  ⭐ 1,240 points   →  $12.40 available
  
  Next renewal earns 200 points ($2.00)
```

### SPEC

| Feature | Value |
|---|---|
| Points per renewal | Show in subscription widget: "Earn 200 pts" |
| Streak display | Days/renewals active, visual flame or bar |
| Redemption | Allow points redemption at checkout (applied to next charge) |
| Milestone rewards | Free product at 6/12 months — show progress |
| Cancel penalty | Show "You'll lose your X-day streak" in cancel flow |

### BRAND EXAMPLES

- **AG1:** "Day streak" prominently in account portal. Each day of subscription extends streak. Massive retention driver.
- **Olly:** Points per order, visible in cart and confirmation. Recharge + Loyalty Lion integration.
- **Ritual:** "Essential streak" — days since first subscription. Anniversary gifts at 3/6/12 months.

### ANTI-PATTERNS

- Do NOT hide point balance — show it everywhere (PDP, cart, account)
- Do NOT let points expire without prominent warnings
- Do NOT make redemption complex — one-click apply at checkout

---

## CROSS-PATTERN INTEGRATION MAP

```
PDP SubscribeWidget
    → selects selling plan
    → passed to CartLineAdd (Hydrogen)
    → cart shows subscription badge per line
    → checkout shows "Subscription" label
    → post-checkout: show upsell if one-time
    → account portal: manage subscription
    → renewal webhook → loyalty points credited
    → streak updated in account UI
```

---

## SHOPIFY STOREFRONT API FRAGMENTS

```graphql
# Include in product queries to power subscription UI
fragment SellingPlansFragment on Product {
  sellingPlanGroups(first: 2) {
    nodes {
      name
      appName
      options { name values }
      sellingPlans(first: 4) {
        nodes {
          id
          name
          description
          options { name value }
          priceAdjustments {
            orderCount
            adjustmentValue {
              ... on SellingPlanPercentagePriceAdjustment {
                adjustmentPercentage
              }
              ... on SellingPlanFixedAmountPriceAdjustment {
                adjustmentAmount { amount currencyCode }
              }
            }
          }
          recurringDeliveries
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

---

## TESTING CHECKLIST

- [ ] Subscribe widget visible above ATC on mobile and desktop
- [ ] Frequency selector opens/closes correctly
- [ ] Price updates live when switching one-time ↔ subscribe
- [ ] Selected selling plan ID passes correctly to cart
- [ ] Cart shows subscription indicator on line item
- [ ] Subscription portal: skip, pause, cancel all functional
- [ ] Cancel flow: save offer triggers for "too expensive" reason
- [ ] Bundle builder: progress bar accurate, ATC blocked when incomplete
- [ ] Post-checkout upsell: does NOT show if already subscribed
- [ ] Loyalty points: displayed in widget, credited after renewal webhook
